#
# `compute_gas` is the post-transaction compute-gas tracker reading; `gas_used` is the
# receipt value, which is neither counter nor their sum: refunds lower it, gas consumed
# outside a completed window raises it, and the calldata floor can raise it further.
#
# Frozen specs (Equivalence through Rex6) must never change: a diff there is a
# replay-breaking regression.
#
